purpose: Define Fun Mode as an optional 3D Viewer presentation layer scoped to Projector cameras only.
invariants: Fun Mode exists only in the Projector 3D Viewer.
Fun Mode MUST NOT appear in Inputs, Mapper, Planner, Compare, Conformance, Exporter or non-3D views.
Fun Mode is presentation-only and MUST NOT mutate CW, StructureTree, mappings, conformance results, input definitions, Scene semantics or source evidence.
Each camera MAY have its own Fun Mode enabled state and preset/settings.
Switching cameras restores that camera's own Fun Mode state together with its other camera-specific Viewer settings.
Fun Mode may animate, stylize or overlay only information already available to the 3D Viewer; it MUST NOT invent semantic facts.
Disabling Fun Mode returns the camera to the normal 3D presentation without changing any semantic or structural state.
